purpose: Test whether real Qwen representations admit family-resolved, gauge-invariant identity patches across context and runtime precision, and emit receipts consumable by the Godel globe, VPD edit program, and HRMmmm control harness.
claim_boundary: This target-blind protocol measures spectral identity geometry. It does not establish semantic identity, causal edit value, capability preservation, compactification, recursive improvement, or RSI. The archived Silico run is calibration only. No outcome-bearing intervention is performed here.
precision_axis_rule: Weights, tokenizer, prompts, token positions, sites, and batch membership are identical across arms. Models are loaded and released sequentially. A float32-only pass is runtime_specific_identity and cannot authorize bfloat16 use.

capture_contract.activation_site: registered v_proj module output at the final non-padding prompt token
capture_contract.chunk_unit: one runtime_precision x site x context_shard x half array
capture_contract.chunk_format: NPZ with exactly one finite rank-2 array named activations; prompt row order is sealed in capture_index.json
capture_contract.checkpoint_cadence: after every context-shard/half forward batch and no less often than every 300 seconds
capture_contract.cleanup: release hooks, model, tokenizer, batches, and tensors; gc.collect; synchronize/empty CUDA cache/ipc cache; terminate only registered owned PIDs; emit cleanup receipt

primary_object.rank_selection: largest prefix rank passing the strict bootstrap-versus-label-permutation margin on every registered node of the relevant runtime grid

instrument_calibration.kind: matched_random_named_family positive construction plus label-permutation null
instrument_calibration.interpretation: This is a planted instrument calibration. It is distinct from the real primary object's label-permutation null and is not real-model evidence.
instrument_calibration.failure_effect: All certificates cap at engineering_evidence with negative_control_not_passed.

graph.edges: adjacent context shards within each runtime plus same-shard cross-runtime edges
graph.adjacent_depth_edges: negative-boundary report only; never used to manufacture loops

holonomy.construction_validation_agreement: compare determinant component and sorted canonical-angle spectrum
holonomy.nontrivial_signal: validation maximum canonical angle must exceed the matched flat/noise 95th percentile; aggregate support requires at least three sites across two families
holonomy.area_law_status: secondary calibration only on the regular 2x8 registered grid
holonomy.det_negative: categorical orientation reversal; suppress canonical angles

corotation.comparison: construction-versus-validation within-family distance against matched cross-family distance at equal supported rank
corotation.gate: 95% lower confidence bound of cross-family median distance minus within-family median distance is strictly positive
corotation.failure_effect: render independent family globes; do not invalidate identity attestation

sectioning.stability_rule: The 95% bootstrap interval for patch-count change from six to eight shards must lie within plus/minus max(1, 10% of the six-shard count).
sectioning.ceiling_effect: Use hierarchical navigation; do not declare the geometry false.

chronology.pre_run: pushed Git commit or tag plus sealed protocol, prompt, capture-index template, environment, and source hashes

causal_handoff.condition: Only existing P1-passing holonomy-clean patches may be sealed for its still-unread P2 holdout.
